text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Customs (Customs Airports) Regulations.

heading.en: Customs airports for separate and exclusive import, export and transhipment

text.en:
3.—(1) All such part of ACE Hub under the possession and management of Federal Express (Singapore) Pte Ltd is a customs airport reserved for the separate and exclusive import, export and transhipment of goods by air by Federal Express (Singapore) Pte Ltd.
(2) [Deleted by S 673/2024 wef 01/09/2024]
(3) In this regulation, “ACE Hub” means the Air Cargo Express Hub within the Air Cargo Express Free Trade Zone at Changi Airport.
[S 673/2024 wef 01/09/2024]
[S 337/2018 wef 02/06/2018]
